page: Microsoft Azure L8aos_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 AMD processor configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 64 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of 8 GB of RAM per vCPU. The configuration does not include hardware graphical processing units.

The primary architectural characteristic of the L8aos_v5 is its integrated local storage configuration, featuring 5760 GB of directly attached NVMe SSD storage alongside support for Premium Storage. This setup delivers low latency and high local disk throughput, reducing external network storage reliance for read- and write-intensive operations. The instance provision does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an operational perspective, pairing 8 dedicated cores with 5760 GB of local NVMe SSD and 64 GB of memory targets data-heavy workloads requiring dense local cache or high transactional storage capacity without deploying oversized clusters. The hardware layout is suitable for transactional databases, NoSQL engines, large log indexing systems, data warehousing, and ETL batch processing pipelines that require direct NVMe storage access.
